defect: The fix adds a const char* SetError overload that maps NULL to an empty message, because callers added later (e.g. the StatementExecuteQuery bind path passing duckdb_prepare_error) handed NULL to the std::string overload.
reason: This change only exposed the existing std::string SetError in the header; the NULL crash comes from later call sites, and the replaced CHECK_RES macro already did strdup on possibly-NULL messages.

defect: The fix makes a NULL home_directory value map to an empty string instead of the literal text NULL.
reason: For NULL input the old inverted ternary also returned input.ToString(), so the NULL handling was already wrong before this change, which only fixed the non-NULL case.

defect: The rewritten SplitStringMapInternal returns false when a map key is empty ('Key can not be empty'), so casts of maps with empty keys now fail.
reason: The removed FindKeyOrValueMap accepted an empty key (HandleKey on an empty range), so the rejection the fix removes was added by this change.

defect: The fix resolves a merge conflict by passing the Python object to the reworked IsAcceptedArrowObject and computing the type name only for the error.
reason: It adapts to a later API change of IsAcceptedArrowObject; nothing in this change was wrong.

defect: CreateEntry passes the parameter name (which shadows the member name) to SetFrom instead of the owning entry's name, and Scan still filters by prefix, which the new constructor no longer initializes, so it matches every entry.
reason: Both the SetFrom call and the switch of ApplyPrefix to mangled_name while Scan kept prefix were made in this change and are what the fix repairs.

defect: The fix only removes the prefix member that later code stopped using.
reason: In this change prefix was initialized with null-byte separators and used consistently by ApplyPrefix and Scan; the inconsistency appeared in c03f6e5.

defect: SortVariantKeys now writes every dictionary entry into the keys list, which is sized only by the number of key uses, so struct keys emplaced for null or empty struct rows make it write past the list (out of bounds).
reason: Before this change StringDictionary::AddString reserved the list for every entry; this change moved the dictionary to an OrderedOwningStringMap and added the unchecked keys_entry_data[i] write that the fix guards and the struct-side fix avoids.

defect: The fix emplaces struct keys into the dictionary only once a valid row is seen, so all-NULL structs add no unused keys.
reason: This change only moved ConvertStructToVariant from to_variant.cpp into a header; the eager dictionary emplacement was already there.

defect: The fix makes InitializeScanWithOffset compute the child offset relative to start.
reason: This change only added a TODO comment to the assert; the wrong child offset was already present.

defect: The fix converts a hugeint decimal constant to a Python int by hand before building the pyarrow scalar, since hugeint_t has no pybind11 caster.
reason: The previous code already passed GetValue<hugeint_t>() straight to pyarrow, so hugeint pushdown was broken before this change.

defect: The fix replaces col.name with col.Name() after the ColumnDefinition API changed.
reason: It is a build fix for a later API change, not a defect of this change.

defect: The fix changes GetRandomizedVector to take a range and a size so fewer random numbers are drawn.
reason: It is a performance change, not a correctness repair.

defect: The fix detects a leading minus after skipping whitespace instead of testing buf[0].
reason: The yearneg = (buf[0] == '-') logic predates this change, which only swapped std::isdigit for CharacterIsDigit.

defect: The regenerated Deserialize uses TableFilterType::OPTIONAL, which does not exist (the enum value is OPTIONAL_FILTER), so the file does not compile.
reason: This change introduced the case label that the fix reverts, and the enum in table_filter.hpp only has OPTIONAL_FILTER.

defect: The fix defers pushing ORDER BY and DISTINCT ON expressions into the select list until table names are bound, to avoid redundant projections.
reason: This change only renamed uint32_t/uint64_t to index_t; the binder design that causes redundant projections predates it.

defect: The fix defers pushing extra ORDER BY and DISTINCT ON expressions into the select list until after table names are bound, and remaps their indices.
reason: OrderBinder already pushed unbound expressions for ORDER BY, and the replaced DistinctBinder did the same; reusing OrderBinder did not create the problem.

defect: The fix collects extra ORDER BY expressions in a separate list instead of pushing them into the select list directly.
reason: This change only renamed count_t to index_t; the redundant projection behaviour predates it.

defect: The fix only reformats includes, whitespace and the nested MinValue expression.
reason: It is a formatting change, not a defect repair.

defect: TempDirectorySetting::SetGlobal recomputes the default max swap space only when the new temp directory is non-empty, so SET temp_directory='' keeps a stale non-zero max_temp_directory_size.
reason: This change added the non-empty guard around SetDefaultMaxSwapSpace, and the fix removes it so the default is recomputed (to 0) for an empty directory.

defect: The fix initializes correlated_payload with InitializeEmpty instead of Initialize, avoiding buffers that are immediately replaced by Reference.
reason: Allocating buffers and then referencing other vectors is wasteful but gives correct results, so there is no defect for this hunk.

defect: The fix takes gstate.lock only after CombineDistinct, so the distinct radix-table combine no longer runs under the global lock (deadlock).
reason: This change refactored only the Sink signatures; the lock held around CombineDistinct in Combine is not from its lines.

defect: In this file the fix only changes access specifiers and a comment.
reason: No defect in this change's lines is repaired here; the deadlock fix is in the ungrouped aggregate.

defect: Pin reloads an unloaded buffer only when is_pipe is true, although AllocateBuffer makes buffers destroyable exactly when is_pipe is false, so evicted non-pipe buffers are not reloaded (and is_pipe is initialized from OnDiskFile).
reason: This change introduced is_pipe, the can_destroy = !is_pipe rule and the is_pipe reload condition the fix inverts; the inconsistency is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix takes the selection vector from keys.sel_vector, sets the cardinality after each NotNullSelVector, and sets the mark-join result cardinality first.
reason: This change's per-iteration SetCardinality is equivalent to the old per-column SetSelVector/SetCount; the lines the fix corrects (keys.data[0].sel_vector(), ConstructMarkJoinResult) were not changed by it.

defect: The fix returns the cached chunk with chunk.Reference(cached_chunk) instead of referencing columns and copying sel_vector by hand.
reason: This change only rewrote column_count to column_count(); the manual reference and sel_vector copy predate it.

defect: The fix finishes a trailing-delimiter last line with AddValue and AddRow, so column-count checks and an ignored trailing NULL value apply.
reason: This change only corrected the value end to actual_size - 1, which AddValue(actual_size) reproduces; adding the last row with AddRowInternal and no row checks predates it.

defect: The fix stops pushing an OR filter when one child is not a simple column-constant comparison, instead of skipping that child.
reason: The duplicated same_column_id assignment added here is harmless; the continue that dropped non-simple disjuncts was already present.

defect: The added FinalizeCheckpoint verification throws an InternalException when new segment starts do not follow col_data.start, which is not an invariant here, so valid checkpoints fail.
reason: The check was added by this change and removed the same day as incorrect; whether it holds depends on how segment starts are set in other files.

defect: The fix makes Glob skip empty path segments correctly, supports ~, and returns an empty result instead of throwing the 'Eeek' internal error.
reason: In this change every path yields at least one split and the last split always returns, so the throw only became reachable after later absolute-path and empty-segment changes.

defect: The fix makes the new tests read the string through duckdb_string_t_data and duckdb_string_t_length instead of the inlined struct fields.
reason: It is a test-only change.

defect: The real fix stores pinned handles by block id in tuple_data_allocator.cpp; in this file it only adds asserts and cosmetic edits.
reason: The random pin order is a defect of the allocator, and FindOrCreateGroupsInternal already relied on block order before this change.

defect: The fix adds explicit double casts in GetProgress.
reason: 100.0 * idx_t is already evaluated in floating point, so the casts are a style change, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix switches file parsing to yyjson in-situ mode (YYJSON_READ_INSITU via yyjson_read_opts) together with a rework of the unstructured buffer handling.
reason: The non-in-situ read copies the input but parses correctly; the change in this file is a performance and design change, and the buffer bugs are in json_scan.cpp.

defect: The fix reworks unstructured JSON buffering (prev_buffer_remainder, padding, one reader per buffer, is_last against the reduced request size).
reason: All repaired logic concerns the unstructured format added in later commits; for newline-delimited files this change's is_last and readers logic is unchanged by the fix.

defect: After freeing the Node4, DeleteChild marks the freed node as LEAF_INLINED, so the prefix argument (which aliases node when there is no prefix) looks like a leaf, violating Prefix::Concat's D_ASSERT(!parent.IsAnyLeaf()) and leaving a bogus inlined leaf.
reason: This change introduced the FreeNode plus SetMetadata(LEAF_INLINED) trick that the fix removes; seeing the problem needs the Erase caller and Prefix::Concat.

defect: The benchmark caches the generated database under the fixed name tpcds, ignoring SF, so after the scale factor changes a stale database of the wrong scale is loaded silently.
reason: This change introduced the cache with a key that omits the scale factor; the fix adds the SF to the key.

defect: The fix reorders the MetricsType enum to match the generator's output.
reason: It regenerates the file in sorted order to satisfy the generation check, not to repair behaviour.

defect: The fix initializes internal nodes to num_leaf_nodes - 1 instead of 0, so padded internal nodes do not point at leaf 0.
reason: With this change's n-1 internal nodes, every node is recomputed from real leaves, so the zero initialization was harmless; padding to a power of two came in a later rework.

defect: After state became a raw pointer, operator= still asserts RefersToSameObject(state, other.state), which compares the addresses of the two pointer members and fails for every non-self assignment (and does not allow a null default-constructed state).
reason: This change turned state into STATE* and added the null default constructor without updating the assert that the fix rewrites; seeing it needs RefersToSameObject's definition.

defect: input_chunk and lambda_chunk are now initialized once and reused for every ExecuteExpression batch, but executing the lambda and referencing slices leaves their vectors changed, so later batches produce wrong results.
reason: Before this change ExecuteExpression re-initialized both chunks for each batch; the fix goes back to fresh chunks per batch.
